# Third-party material in fixtures/jsgraph

## rea/ (generated by gen_rea_apps.mjs)

Application trees derived from the test fixtures of REA (https://github.com/morluto/rea, commit 0fa0b04,
MIT License). The files are generated by `gen_rea_apps.mjs` from REA's own fixture modules and are used
only to compare this Rust port with the original implementation.

## semantic/snippets.json (generated by scripts/gen_jsgraph_semantic_snippets.mjs)

JavaScript sources lifted from the unit tests of REA (`src/domain/javascript` and
`src/application/javascript` `*.test.ts`, commit 0fa0b04, MIT License, text above). Used only as
test input; the expected results come from running REA itself.

The inline scenarios in `crates/js/tests/snippets/` and `crates/js/tests/support/derived_scenarios.rs`
are partly taken from the same REA unit tests (MIT License, text above).

## npm/

Unmodified contents of the published packages `ms@2.1.3`, `escape-html@1.0.3` and `commander@14.0.3` (all MIT;
each directory carries the package's own license file). Tarball integrity (ms, escape-html) or the registry
integrity of the published tarball (commander) and per-file digests are pinned in `PINS.json`. `commander`
brings real `typings/index.d.ts` and `typings/esm.d.mts` declaration files (the REA MCP answer for the whole
package exceeds its stdio budget, so it feeds the per-file layer corpora, not the application-graph roots).

## dts/

Unmodified declaration files (`.d.ts`, `.d.mts`, `.d.cts`) copied from the npm packages in REA's dependency
tree, kept under `<package>-<version>/` with the package's own license text next to them. The license of each
package was read from its `package.json` (the copy asserts it). Per-file digests are in `dts/PINS.json`.

| Directory | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `types-node-26.6.4` | `@types/node@26.6.4` | MIT (Microsoft Corporation) |
| `typescript-linux-x64-7.0.2` | `@typescript/typescript-linux-x64@7.0.2` | Apache-2.0 (Microsoft Corporation; `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.txt` kept, the file carries its own Apache header) |
| `isomorphic-git-1.38.7` | `isomorphic-git@1.38.7` | MIT |
| `mdast-util-to-hast-13.2.1` | `mdast-util-to-hast@13.2.1` | MIT |
| `jridgewell-trace-mapping-0.3.31` | `@jridgewell/trace-mapping@0.3.31` | MIT |
| `jose-6.2.3` | `jose@6.2.3` | MIT |
| `vfile-6.0.3` | `vfile@6.0.3` | MIT |

They are used only to compare this Rust port with the original implementation on declaration files.

## own/

Fixtures written for this project (MIT, same license as the repository). The same applies to
`syntax_errors.txt`, `gen_rea_apps.mjs` and the oracle drivers in `oracle/` (they load REA from a
user-provided checkout; no REA code is copied into them). `own/ambient-cases/` holds the
minimal declaration-file cases (and `.ts` counterparts) that exercise Babel's ambient-context and
module/namespace scope rules; `own/dts-app/` is a small application with `.d.ts`, `.d.mts` and `.d.cts` files.
